rule: The target is Grappled and Restrained (escape DC 14) until the grapple ends.
The target is Poisoned on the first failure and Stunned on the second failure.
The target is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

conditions.duration: until the end of its next turn

rule: The target is Frightened while the beacon is visible.
The target is Poisoned for 2 rounds.
